Tracks the GOG product under identifier `1207659008`, including installer versions, languages, downloads, and changes to the package.

The retrieved record includes a Windows installer labeled `1.1 hotfix GOG v2`, plus a manual and soundtrack among the extras. This is useful for determining which edition a compatibility report refers to and following changes that a storefront description may not preserve.

A [second product record](https://www.gogdb.org/product/1505419307) also exists; it should not be assumed to be a separate original game release merely because the identifier differs.

**Limitations:** this is an independent metadata service, not an official changelog. Download presence and sizes can change, and the actual installer contents were not inspected.
